directions.opportunity: checkQualityState recomputes the full evidence fingerprint (one read + SHA-256 per evidence file) for every PASS candidate in the active log and once more for the final dirty verdict, re-hashing the same unchanged files each time; with the append-only log growing one record per review/optimize round, every quality invocation degrades to O(passCandidates × evidenceFiles) I/O (32+ evidence files here).
directions.impact: Bounds evidence file reads and hashing per quality command to O(distinct evidence paths) instead of O(passCandidates × evidenceFiles), keeping `quality status`, review, optimize, seal, sync/archive gates, list, and apply-instructions latency flat as round history accumulates, with byte-identical outputs.
evidence: src/core/quality/state.ts:133-146 — `for (const candidate of [snapshot, ...log.slice().reverse()])` calls computeEvidenceFingerprint(candidate.verificationContext?.evidenceFiles ?? [], projectRoot) for every contractVersion-matching PASS candidate until one matches
src/core/quality/state.ts:158-165 — the final dirty branch recomputes the snapshot fingerprint after every candidate already failed
src/core/quality/state.ts:45-78 — computeEvidenceFingerprint reads and SHA-256 hashes every listed file on each call, no shared caching
src/commands/quality.ts:126,181 — runQualityReview invokes checkQualityState twice per command (entry plus post-write), same pattern at 197,299 for optimize; single calls at 320,345 (status, seal)

src/commands/sync.ts:56, src/core/archive.ts:197, src/core/list.ts:32, src/commands/workflow/instructions.ts:338 — sync/archive gates, list, and apply instructions also run checkQualityState, so the cost recurs across surfaces
src/core/quality/log.ts:35-53 — readQualityLog returns every appended record, so the candidate set grows monotonically within a change
directions.recommendation: Memoize per-file hash and skip results within one checkQualityState invocation and share that cache across all candidate fingerprint computations and the final snapshot fingerprint computation.
directions.keyDesign: Add a module-private computeEvidenceFingerprintCached(evidenceFiles, projectRoot, cache) where cache is a Map<string, { entry?: EvidenceFingerprintEntry; skipped?: string }> keyed by the resolved evidence path; checkQualityState creates one cache before the candidate loop and passes it to every candidate computation and to the final dirty-branch computation, so identical paths are hashed once per invocation. The exported computeEvidenceFingerprint delegates with a fresh Map, keeping its public signature and per-call freshness unchanged; candidates with differing evidenceFiles lists are handled naturally by the per-path key.
preservationConstraints: Clean/dirty verdicts, matched-candidate selection order (snapshot first, then log newest-first), changedFiles output, composeStateRecord ledger take-over from the latest snapshot, and archive-compatibility results are identical for every input

All fingerprint derivation steps unchanged: input sort, QUALITY_RECORD_FILES skip, ENOENT/EISDIR skip, POSIX relative path normalization, localeCompare entry ordering, and the SHA-256-of-JSON-entries hash

Cache lifetime is strictly one checkQualityState invocation: nothing inside the invocation writes evidence files (only quality record files are written elsewhere and they are excluded from fingerprints), so cached bytes equal re-read bytes; no module-level, cross-invocation, or persisted cache
exported computeEvidenceFingerprint keeps its signature and re-reads files on every direct call; no public API or type changes
implementationOutline: In src/core/quality/state.ts add the private cached helper that consults and populates the per-path cache for hash and skip decisions while reusing the existing sort, skip, and normalization logic
Create the cache at the top of checkQualityState and route the candidate-loop computation and the final dirty-branch snapshot computation through it
Keep computeEvidenceFingerprint as a thin wrapper that creates a fresh cache and delegates
Run the existing quality state and command suites plus tsc; add no new exports or fixtures beyond what the suites already cover
validation: pnpm exec vitest run test/core/quality/state.test.ts test/commands/quality.test.ts must pass unchanged — these pin clean/dirty verdicts, historical-PASS matching after rollback, latest-ledger take-over, unsafe gates, and seal behavior, proving output equivalence
pnpm exec tsc --noEmit exits 0 — no type regressions

Claim proven by construction: per-invocation evidence reads are bounded by the number of distinct evidence paths regardless of PASS-candidate count, verifiable by inspection of the single shared cache
directions.priorityReason: Ranks first because it is the only direction with a measurable hot-path effect: every quality subcommand, sync/archive gate, list, and apply instruction re-hashes all evidence files once per PASS candidate, and the candidate set grows with each recorded round; the improvement is statically provable and output-identical. The other direction is a low-impact prose clarity fix.
